description: Use this when the user asks which supplier bills they owe, what is overdue to suppliers, or what they must pay in the next few days. Unpaid supplier bills that are overdue or due within days (default 30, up to 120): supplier, bill number, dates, amount, paid and remaining (after payments, supplier credits, advances and credit notes, as on the Bills page), with totals per currency split into overdue and not yet due (due_soon). Lists at most 50; when has_more is true, say how many there are. Unpaid bills without a due date are only counted. Needs access to expenses. Do not use it for money clients owe them (list_invoices with status overdue, list_clients).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

days.description: Bills due within this many days from today, 0 to 120. Default 30.
